title: Semiconductor Processing Technicians
description: Perform any or all of the following functions in the manufacture of electronic semiconductors: load semiconductor material into furnace; saw formed ingots into segments; load individual segment into crystal growing chamber and monitor controls; locate crystal axis in ingot using x-ray equipment and saw ingots into wafers; and clean, polish, and load wafers into series of special purpose furnaces, chemical baths, and equipment used to form circuitry and change conductive properties.

tasks.text: Inspect materials, components, or products for surface defects and measure circuitry, using electronic test equipment, precision measuring instruments, microscope, and standard procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Study work orders, instructions, formulas, and processing charts to determine specifications and sequence of operations.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Clean semiconductor wafers using cleaning equipment, such as chemical baths, automatic wafer cleaners, or blow-off wands.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of physical workpieces

dwas.name: Clean workpieces or finished products.

tasks.text: Maintain processing, production, and inspection information and reports.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Place semiconductor wafers in processing containers or equipment holders, using vacuum wand or tweezers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Assemble precision electronics or optical equipment.
Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Load and unload equipment chambers and transport finished product to storage or to area for further processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.

tasks.text: Manipulate valves, switches, and buttons, or key commands into control panels to start semiconductor processing cycles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Command entry often needs physical equipment interface

dwas.name: Enter commands, instructions, or specifications into equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect equipment for leaks, diagnose malfunctions, and request repairs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.
Diagnose equipment malfunctions.
Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Stamp, etch, or scribe identifying information on finished component according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Engraving requires controlled hand tool operation

dwas.name: Engrave designs, text, or other markings onto materials, workpieces, or products.

tasks.text: Clean and maintain equipment, including replacing etching and rinsing solutions and cleaning bath containers and work area.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean workpieces or finished products.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Monitor operation and adjust controls of processing machines and equipment to produce compositions with specific electronic properties, using computer terminals.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical product flaw monitoring is on-machine

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual loading into hot ovens or furnaces

dwas.name: Load items into ovens or furnaces.

tasks.text: Count, sort, and weigh processed items.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Counting physical products needs presence or sensors

dwas.name: Count finished products or workpieces.
Weigh finished products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Sort materials or products for processing, storing, shipping, or grading.

tasks.text: Scribe or separate wafers into dice.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on industrial material cutting

dwas.name: Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Calculate etching time based on thickness of material to be removed from wafers or crystals.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Production requirement calc; human validates inputs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.

tasks.text: Etch, lap, polish, or grind wafers or ingots to form circuitry and change conductive properties, using etching, lapping, polishing, or grinding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Precision electronics assembly needs fine dexterity

dwas.name: Assemble precision electronics or optical equipment.

tasks.text: Align photo mask pattern on photoresist layer, expose pattern to ultraviolet light, and develop pattern, using specialized equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Precision electronics assembly needs fine dexterity

dwas.name: Assemble precision electronics or optical equipment.
